_about: Function-tool definitions for API deployments of the NTXP Plans Atlas. Written in the OpenAI function-calling shape, which the xAI (Grok) API also accepts. For the Anthropic Messages API, use each function's name and description unchanged and pass its 'parameters' object as 'input_schema'. The host executes a call with: python scripts/run_tool.py <name> '<arguments-json>'

function.name: deploy_plans_atlas
function.description: Deploy or update the NTXP Plans Atlas for a project. It discovers the drawing PDFs under the project's Construction Documents folder, extracts sheets, callout links and the trade/spec/phase/area index, renders the offline viewer to 'Construction Documents/Plans Atlas/plans-atlas.html', and records a SHA-256 drawing manifest. It is idempotent: an unchanged drawing set returns status 'up_to_date' without rebuilding. Call it automatically when a bid is confirmed, when a project is confirmed, and when addenda or revised sheets arrive. Returns JSON: status (built | up_to_date | no_drawings), atlas path, sheets, event, atlas_version.

event.description: Why the deployment is running; recorded in the atlas state.

const_docs.description: Construction Documents folder. Omit to auto-detect it, or to create it if absent.

pdf_dir.description: Folder holding the drawing PDFs. Defaults to the Construction Documents folder.

dossier.description: Dossier directory for model assembly. Defaults to the project root.

force.description: Rebuild even when the drawing set is unchanged.

check.description: Only report whether a rebuild is needed; change nothing.

dry_run.description: Print the deployment plan; change nothing.

function.name: render_plans_atlas_viewer
function.description: Re-render only the Plans Atlas viewer HTML from an already-built Canonical Project Record, for example to embed it as a fragment or to restyle it without re-extracting drawings. Prefer deploy_plans_atlas for normal deployments.

fragment.description: Emit body-only HTML for embedding in another page.

function.name: project_ignition_blueprint
function.description: Project Ignition stage 1 (deterministic, free). Reads the Canonical Project Record and Plans Atlas and writes model/ignition/blueprint.json plus typed work orders for the two frontier seats (Astra = gpt-6-astra, Opus = claude-opus-5-5) and a Compass work order for public $/SF benchmarks. Call it when a bid is confirmed, after the atlas deploys. Returns JSON: status, divisions, tasks, price_lines, gaps, next steps.

today.description: ISO date to treat as today (optional).

function.name: project_ignition_process
function.description: Project Ignition stage 3 (the Jev work). Reads the raw Astra and Opus outputs saved in model/ignition/raw/, validates them, compares PERT durations and rolls up a CPM schedule, decides unit prices with confidence and valid-through dates, and sanity-checks cost per square foot against localized public benchmarks. Everything is a DRAFT for PM approval. Returns JSON summary; full results in model/ignition/processed.json and jev-judgments.jsonl.

today.description: ISO date to treat as today (optional).

markup_pct.description: Markup fraction added before the $/SF check, for example 0.18.

function.name: project_ignition_itb
function.description: Project Ignition stage 4. Generates 8.5 x 11 ITB packages, one per CSI division, plus a bid-package index and an internal ignition summary. ITB pages carry scope, quantities and schedule only, never our prices. Drafts only; nothing is sent.

today.description: ISO date to treat as today (optional).

function.name: phase1_receive_atlas_request
function.description: Process a Phase 1 drawing handoff. Takes <kb>/handoffs/atlas-request.json staged by the NTXP Estimating Phase 1 skill, seeds the project record from the KB (never over an edited section), deploys the Plans Atlas and the Project Ignition blueprint, interlinks the KB with the drawings, and writes atlas-response.json, plans_atlas.json, interlinks.json and atlas-chunks.json into the KB's atlas/ folder. Idempotent. Returns JSON: status, sheets, kb_links, needs_review, response path.

force.description: Rebuild even if the drawings are unchanged.

no_chain.description: Do not call the Estimating bridge afterwards.
